name: manual_d4ff6f
claim: Verify model ids against the provider's live model list before templating them, and treat a model-id churn as the first suspect for an old unexplained failure: W&B dropped the bare DeepSeek-V4-Flash id (404) and rejects reasoning_effort medium on the V4.1 models (HTTP 400 Invalid request, the old bare Bad Request) while accepting high and low.

decisions.notes: Verifiable steps, 2026-11-12: free GET of the model list listed V4.1-Flash-1017, V4.1-Flash, V4-Flash-0731, V4-Pro-0813 and no bare V4-Flash; the bare id returned 404; effort probes per model returned 200 or 400 deterministically; the reasoning_content pass-back hypothesis for the old failure was tested on tool turns and NOT reproduced, so a negative result is recorded instead of kept as a cause.
